summary: agent shot can scope label resolution and child expansion to Figma nodes subtrees instead of fetching the whole file tree.
reason: Large Figma files make whole-file depth fetches the dominant screenshot latency; subtree fetches preserve the same node-id driven workflow while avoiding broad reads and deep --children depth requirements.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli passes with fake-server coverage asserting --root avoids /v1/files/<key> and --children fetches /v1/files/<key>/nodes for the matched section.
